class: Process lifecycle is confused with application outcome and owner waiting
symptom: A deliberate sponsorship skip appeared as failed exit 1, and an owner handoff appeared as active processing.
root_cause: The CLI collapsed all nonzero outcomes into failure; the dashboard displayed a live process as processing even when its waiting note existed.
why_tests_missed: Tests checked process liveness and application status separately without asserting CLI outcomes or cockpit waiting presentation.
fix: Preserve already-submitted and sponsorship-skip exit codes through the launcher, centralize their display labels, reconcile historical false failures from terminal application status, and show owner waiting separately from process liveness.
prevention: Model process liveness, execution activity and application outcome separately. Test deliberate skips, real failures and waiting workers end to end.
